about: The library books' spots, checked in game by the owner (2026-10). mapID and zx, zy (0..1) are the spot on the zone map; Blackrock Mountain's two use that mountain's own map, which the client gives no id (x, y are on it, in percent). Tools/smoke_test.py checks every LOOT step of the guides against this list.
rules: Each book is its own hand-in quest at your faction's librarian; carry the book for its quest to show.
Rewards: 10 books Friend of the Library (level 1), 20 books Greater Friend (level 20), 25 books Greater Friend (level 30). Counts add up across them.
Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works has two spots: Thelsamar (Loch Modan) and Sentinel Hill (Westfall). Horde may not be able to reach the Thelsamar copy. One copy is enough.
Feralas (The Liminal and the Arcane) is left out: its Forever spot isn't known.
